summary: Iteration 7 – validated the 3 bug fixes on Conoscenza Aperta (article length, missing images, WhatsApp/Telegram OG share) plus a targeted regression sweep. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass in test_iteration7_share_and_length.py. Frontend: article detail page for 'Biofisica quantistica' loads with the new Unsplash image (photo id 1635070041078), summary of 2318 chars containing 'Fritz-Albert Popp', 'Emilio Del Giudice', 'biofotoni', and 'coerenza', and both WhatsApp/Telegram share buttons render pinned at the bottom (testID share-wa / share-tg). Bug 1: every seed article now has summary >= 1500 chars; the shortest is Biofisica at ~2318 chars, all 13 titles migrated. Bug 2: every article returns a non-empty image_url; both Fisica quantistica articles carry the new working Unsplash URL. Bug 3: GET /api/share/article/{id} and /api/share/media/{id} return text/html with og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type=article, twitter:card=summary_large_image, twitter:image — verified against real IDs. Regression stable: /search?q=medita 200, /me/stats returns expected shape (uses 'minutes_meditated' not 'minutes' — noted for future tests), /referrals/me = MAESTRO-2026 for admin, /favorites/toggle 200 with {content_type, content_id}, SoundHelix URLs still on meditation media, admin login OK. No React Native red screens, no deprecated Expo packages, only the harmless expo-notifications web warning.
action_items: No bug fixes needed — all 3 reported bugs are verified fixed and regression is green.
Optional (not blocking): OG share page currently renders og:type='article' also for media share URLs; if strict semantics matter, switch to og:type='video.other' inside share_media_page.
Optional: /me/stats field is 'minutes_meditated' but iteration_6 summary described it as 'minutes' — align docs/UI copy for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1481-1524 _og_html properly HTML-escapes title/description/image/url — safe against XSS via seed content.
server.py:1530-1536 _public_base_url falls back to Host header if X-Forwarded-* is missing — good, but the PUBLIC_HOST env override is a nice escape hatch for CDN cases.
server.py:1539-1560 share endpoints correctly exclude _id via projection and 404 for unknown ids.
migrate_articles.py leaves seed data idempotent (upsert-style set on match by title/category) — safe to re-run, though instructions say do not.
server.py still ~1764 lines (>700 guideline) — future refactor into routers/ (share/, admin/, billing/, content/) recommended but not blocking.
